ValidationRule.description: Requires that if any PG's FICO is < 500 the Personal Credit Policy Exception must be checked prior to Approval
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status__c), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Approved'), OR( VALUE(PG_1_EQF_Score__c)<500, VALUE(PG_2_EQF_Score__c)<500, VALUE(PG_3_EQF_Score__c)<500 ), NOT(INCLUDES( Policy_Exception_Categories__c, 'Personal Credit')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If FICO < 500 Personal Credit Policy Exception must be selected prior to Approval.
